title: Nitrogen, phosphorus and zinc management effects on grain yield and cadmium concentration in two cultivars of durum wheat
notes: Paper reports grain yield and grain Cd concentration but does NOT report grain Zn concentration. Zn applied at 10 kg Zn/ha as ZnSO4. No Zn concentration data available for extraction. Tables 5-6 = yield, Table 7 = Cd concentration only.
